code: (async()=>{const c=document.querySelector('canvas');const gl=c.getContext('webgl2')||c.getContext('webgl');const w=c.width,h=c.height;const buf=new Uint8Array(w*h*4);const read=()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{gl.readPixels(0,0,w,h,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,buf);r();}));let ok=false;for(let i=0;i<8&&!ok;i++){await read();let s=0;for(let k=0;k<buf.length;k+=4001)s+=buf[k];ok=s>0;}const lum=(x,y)=>{const yy=h-1-y;const o=(yy*w+x)*4;return 0.2126*buf[o]+0.7152*buf[o+1]+0.0722*buf[o+2];};const rect=(x0,y0,x1,y1)=>{let s=0,n=0;for(let y=y0;y<y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<x1;x++){s+=lum(x,y);n++;}return Math.round(s/n);};const prof=[];for(let y=0;y<72;y+=4)prof.push(rect(480,y,920,y+4));const map=[];for(let y=380;y<540;y+=16){const row=[];for(let x=680;x<940;x+=16)row.push(rect(x,y,x+16,y+16));map.push(row);}return {ok,wallProfile4px:prof,floorNear:rect(480,80,920,120),floorMid:rect(480,300,920,340),playerMap:map};})()
